---
title: "Text hook"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
calls <- 0
gov <- function(txt) {
  rx <- "\\[([^\\[\\]]*)\\]\\{r=\"([^\"]*)\"\\}"
  while (grepl(rx, txt, perl = TRUE)) {
    m <- regmatches(txt, regexec(rx, txt, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    val <- eval(parse(text = m[3]), knitr::knit_global())
    arms <- trimws(strsplit(m[2], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
    out <- if (is.logical(val)) {
      if (length(arms) == 1) { if (!isTRUE(val)) stop("Claim \"", arms, "\" failed: ", m[3], " was FALSE") ; arms }
      else arms[if (isTRUE(val)) 1 else 2]
    } else gsub("#", format(val), arms[if (val == 1) 1 else 2], fixed = TRUE)
    txt <- sub(m[1], out, txt, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  txt
}
knitr::knit_hooks$set(text = function(x) {
  calls <<- calls + 1
  cat(sprintf("[text hook %d] lines=%s nchar=%d head=%s\n", calls,
      tryCatch(knitr:::current_lines(), error = function(e) "?"), sum(nchar(x)),
      substr(gsub("\n", "\\\\n", paste(x, collapse = "\n")), 1, 50)), file = "hook.log", append = TRUE)
  gov(x)
})
n <- 1
n_gap <- 12
```

First: [a person | # people]{r="n"} responded. Inline is `r n`.
